title: ClinicalTrials and funding adapter skeletons
decisions: ClinicalTrials.gov v2 and NSF Award Search are public, unauthenticated GET APIs used only through the injected Transport.
Both adapters expose the standard source health state inherited from IntelligenceSource and are covered by mock-only tests.
No external request, credential, dependency, or paid source was used by this task.
risks: These are conservative normalization skeletons; field availability and schema evolution remain isolated to the adapters.
NSF Award Search covers NSF funding only, not a global funding corpus.
follow_up: P03-T08: extend source fixtures only if new adapter edge cases require them.
P03-T09: reconcile and audit transport retries, timeouts, and rate limiting.
